note_tweet.text:
11 years later, Vision has gone from a powerful but distant android in Avengers: Age of Ultron to one of the MCU’s most human characters in WandaVision.

His evolution was never just about power. It was about love, identity, grief, and what it truly means to be alive.

But after White Vision regained the original Vision’s memories, one question remained: does remembering who you were make you the same person?

With VisionQuest on the horizon, I’m curious to see whether he’ll reconnect with the person he once was or become something entirely different.

Because there’s a difference between remembering your past and knowing who you are.

And 11 years into his MCU journey, Vision’s most important transformation might still be ahead of him.

#VisionQuest
